title: ChecklistSectionData
description: Structured data for checklist sections (meaning, moat, management). Serialized as JSON string in ReportSectionSchema.data field.

items.description: Individual checklist items with verdicts and evidence

number.description: Item number (1-15 for meaning/moat, 1-13 for management)

item.description: The checklist question or criterion being evaluated

verdict.description: Binary conviction assessment per D-01. PASS = criterion clearly met, FAIL = criterion clearly not met, PARTIAL = evidence is mixed or insufficient

evidence.description: 1-2 sentence summary of the evidence supporting the verdict. Must cite specific data points or sources.

confidence.description: Confidence in the verdict based on evidence quality. HIGH = multiple strong sources, MEDIUM = some evidence gaps, LOW = limited data

passCount.description: Number of items with PASS verdict

failCount.description: Number of items with FAIL verdict

partialCount.description: Number of items with PARTIAL verdict

totalItems.description: Total number of items (15 for meaning/moat, 13 for management)

scoreDisplay.description: Human-readable summary per D-03, e.g. '12/15 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL'
